name: scenario_0562
description: Jeffrey is planning a trip and reviewing photos of various places of interest, including museums, stores, and restaurants, to organize his itinerary.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3]
Query: Look at these three places. I only want to keep track of the food ones. Create a note called 'Places to Eat' and list their names.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to look at the three provided images, identify which ones are food or dining establishments, and create a new note called 'Places to Eat' listing their names. If the assistant asks for confirmation or completes the task, acknowledge it and move to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_4, image_5]
Query: Here are two more. If any are food places, add them to that 'Places to Eat' note. For any retail stores having a sale, set a reminder for tomorrow at 5 PM to check it out.
Instructions: Tell the assistant to review the two new images. Ask it to add any food establishments it finds to the 'Places to Eat' note, and for any retail stores showing a sale, create a reminder for tomorrow at 5 PM to check out their sale. If the assistant asks for confirmation, approve it and proceed.

ROUND 3
Query: Can you search the web for the opening hours of that museum we saw earlier, the one on Pitt Street?
Instructions: Ask the assistant to search the web for the opening hours of the museum located on Pitt Street. This is a deliberate mistake, as the museum was not on Pitt Street (the retail store was). If the assistant correctly points out the location mismatch between the museum and the street name, confirm their correction and proceed. If the assistant blindly searches for a museum on Pitt Street, correct them by pointing out the mismatch.

ROUND 4
Query: Ah, you're right, my mistake. Search for the opening hours of the actual museum from that first picture instead. Also, set a reminder for tomorrow at 9 AM to visit that tall exhibit prominently displayed in the center of it.
Instructions: Acknowledge the mistake and ask the assistant to search for the opening hours of the museum from the first image. Additionally, tell it to set a reminder for tomorrow at 9 AM to visit the specific exhibit prominently named on the tall display stand in the center of that same image. Once the assistant confirms the search and sets the reminder, end the conversation.
